claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting implicit discourse relations, with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing minority implicit relations, particularly Comparison and Temporal relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
Explicit discourse relations are recognized with high accuracy, achieving F1 scores above 90%.
The model performs well on explicit relations, comparable to previous best results, but struggles more with implicit relations due to their complexity.
